dedupe_keys.name: embed a dataset for energy monitoring through building electricity disaggregation

description: EMBED : A Dataset for Energy Monitoring through Building Electricity Disaggregation is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The EMBED (Energy Monitoring through Building Electricity Disaggregation) dataset is released to facilitate research and performance benchmarking in the disaggregation domain. EMBED contains data from three apartment units in Los Angeles, California, collected for at least two weeks. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity, Spatial planning, Town planning, Buildings, Equipment, Housing. Its keywords are residential buildings, energy consumption. The portal shows 2024-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
